question: Can a bounded local/global contradiction gate retain sparse-change adaptation and improve global-change calibration compared with equally informed fitted Bayesian change-point controls, without false changes in null worlds?
hypothesis: Under action-conditioned causal shifts, a thresholded breadth signal can activate global updating only when local contradiction evidence is widespread, avoiding hard local resets and protecting preshift readouts; this may beat separate local and global change point controls but should not beat a correctly specified oracle in expected Brier.

inputs.name: synthetic five-state causal shift generator
inputs.source: stdlib-free JavaScript deterministic xorshift32 streams separately keyed per seed, scenario, phase, action, state; exact executable committed before running; no model weights or external data

frozen_design.worlds: 12 seeds x 3 scenarios=36; observable 5 states, two actions; hidden random 5-state directed cycle per world; action0 unchanged cycle; preshift action1 inverse; postshift action1 swaps two source rows (LOCAL_SWAP), becomes forward cycle (GLOBAL_REVERSE), or stays inverse (NULL). Correct target p=.85, other four p=.0375. Five state names opaque; hidden labels never shown to learners.
frozen_design.train_split: Per state/action: 4 preshift observations, then 3 postshift observations. Same witnesses to each arm. Held: 128 new independent outcomes per state/action, 1280/world, 46,080 total. No hidden source law/mode/swap indices given to any learner.
frozen_design.randomness: 32-bit xorshift PRNG seeded by FNV-1a hash of ASCII 'ENERGY-CAL-05|seed|mode|phase|action|state'. Fresh PRNG per world/phase/action/state. Hidden permutation by Fisher–Yates and two distinct uniformly sampled swapped rows. No reuse of ENERGY-SHIFT-04 original seeds.
frozen_design.capacity: Fixed 2x5x5 Dirichlet row counts plus prereadout snapshots; per row exact Dirichlet(0.5) change Bayes factor from pre/post counts. Candidate: w_local=posterior-change(BF,prior=.25), w_global=posterior-change(sum ln BF,prior=.5); activate global when at least 4 of 5 action1 rows have w_local>=.65; otherwise use local weights. Candidate action1 prediction is w*post-reset predictive+(1-w)*pooled predictive, with w=max(w_local,w_global) for global activated rows. Action0 protected pooled predictions. This is a fixed-context gate, NOT exact Bayesian marginalization.
controls: fully fitted independent-row change Bayes pchange=.25 with soft reset/stay mixtures
fully fitted global change Bayes pchange=.5 from sum per-row log Bayes factors

fully fitted hierarchical Bayesian mixture of no-change/local-independent/global-change hypotheses with prior (.25,.50,.25), local-change Bernoulli prior .25 integrated exactly across five rows; this is the STRONGEST conventional control

correctly specified exact graph Bayesian oracle over all 24 hidden cycles and 12 shift hypotheses, equal 1/3 mode priors with uniform 1/10 swap choices within local mode, a source-family oracle floor only
frozen_design.metric: multiclass Brier held action1 primary; overall and by scenario, false trigger >=4 local rows under NULL, unchanged action0 readout Brier after post fitting, JSON roundtrip of preshift predictions, serialized size and CPU if available (otherwise efficiency UNVERIFIED). Matched train/held total plus each arm's prediction count.
frozen_design.budget: Exactly 36 worlds 2,520 training events, 46,080 held events, one scored primary call; smoke only on disjoint seed 93097. No threshold adjustment, new optimizer search, original-world trials or additional model calls. No CI workflow dispatch. Record raw metric per world to repo if small.

classification_rules.supported: Candidate improves post action1 Brier by >=0.01 against BEST of all fully fitted conventional arms INCLUDING hierarchical Bayes, and NULL false global triggers 0/12, all 36 preshift readouts byte-preserved by JSON, and action0 Brier within .01 of best protected conventional action0. Independent dual-OS science acceptance and genuine separate-process cold restore still distinct.
classification_rules.mixed: Candidate improves >=.01 over weaker individual local or global change Bayes in either LOCAL_SWAP or GLOBAL_REVERSE but fails strongest overall or negative controls; no scientific gain.
classification_rules.negative: Neither supported nor mixed but correct source, data and controls; report also negative-control false alarms.
classification_rules.invalid: Missing/wrong strongest comparator, any source mismatch at execution, observed primary before prereg/source commit, tuning on outcomes, hidden-source leakage, replay or swapped train/held witnesses.
classification_rules.efficiency: No efficiency success may be claimed without separately measured all-in cold fit, model selection, checkpoint restore, full prediction cost, memory and OS baseline. JS Date.now() coarse timing is diagnostic-only.

prohibited_after_primary_run: alter priors, thresholds, controls or splits after results
claim exact Bayesian expected-Brier superiority as a novel mechanism
native model integration or canonical checkpoint mutation
preregistration_note: Must be remotely committed before any experimental source, smoke or primary. The exact executable file must be committed/read-back verified before a single primary run. Follow-up work stays on existing draft PR #1346.
